text:
Mia: Heads-up — we're planning to roll out a tiny, timeboxed 'audit-transfer' view to help incident triage teams share scrubbed snapshots with external forensics. Need quick alignment on RBAC + KMS unwrap flow.
Ryan: scope? who can request transfers and where do files land (s3 / partner bucket)?
Mia: initial scope = security + oncall + legal. Destination = short-lived presigned S3 in a partner account (audit-transfer-bucket). TTL 24h.
Alex: prefer ephemeral S3 + envelope encryption. KMS should only unwrap the envelope key for the exact object and log the unwrap. Do not give long-term CMK grants to partner SA.
Sara: question — how do we record the justification and reviewers? want this tied to a ticket id and the requestor's email.
Mia: yes — require a ticket reference and a JIT approver from Legal or SOC. We'll store the ticket id in object metadata and in the access audit log.
Ryan: RBAC idea: new role audit_transfer_requester (can create request), audit_transfer_approver (can approve + trigger export), audit_transfer_reader (short-lived creds to download). All grants issued via OPA + ticket annotation. Thoughts?
Alex: sounds good. Add constraint: requester cannot be approver on same ticket. Enforce via OPA policy.
Sara: KMS flow: object encrypted with ephemeral data key. Envelope key encrypted with CMK (redwood-audit-cmk). Approver's approval triggers a KMS decrypt-as-a-service call which unwraps data key for presigned object creation. The unwrap should be timeboxed and logged to the audit Kinesis.
Mia: agree. Also we should redact PII before transfer. We'll run existing scrubber with the 'triage' profile. Any edge cases where scrubber misses secrets?
Alex: include a quick checksum + sample diff snapshot in ticket for reviewers to sanity check redaction. Also mark file as "forensics-only" to prevent re-ingestion.
sec-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/audit-transfer — includes allowlist, scrub profiles, and CMK ARNs. :link:
Oncall: rollback plan? if we need to stop, how do we revoke presigned links and KMS unwraps immediately?
Ryan: revoke plan: 1) block creation of new presigned URLs by denying kms:Decrypt on redwood-audit-cmk 2) invalidate existing presigned by rotating token used in signed URL generation (short TTL helps) 3) revoke audit_transfer_reader role bindings.
Mia: actionable items: Ryan -> draft OPA policies + role names, Alex -> KMS unwrap service changes (log unwrap events + ticket id), Sara -> scrubber checks and sample diff hook, Sec -> add playbook addendum. Target: start canary in dev in 48h.
Sara: FYI I'll run 5 sample exports through scrubber tonight and post diffs.
Alex: quick snippet for the unwrap call we discussed:
```
POST /kms/unwrap
{ "cmk": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:cmk/redwood-audit-cmk", "ciphertext": "...", "ticket_id": "INC-1234" }
```
Mia: thanks — will follow up in the runbook PR. :thumbsup:
Oncall: ack, will prepare oncall playbook steps for incident run.
Ryan: will draft OPA + IAM snippets and post here before EOD.
Mia: perfect. If anyone hits blockers ping me or add to the ticket INC-1234.
